thessalonians1.5.p1.b1.text: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.

thessalonians1.5.p1.b2.text: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

thessalonians1.5.p1.b3.text: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, … and they will not escape.

thessalonians1.5.p2.b1.text: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; …

thessalonians1.5.p2.b2.text: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.

thessalonians1.5.p2.b3.text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

thessalonians1.5.p3.b1.text: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

thessalonians1.5.p3.b2.text: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.

thessalonians1.5.p3.b3.text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.

thessalonians1.5.p4.b1.text: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, …

thessalonians1.5.p4.b2.text: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

thessalonians1.5.p4.b3.text: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.

thessalonians1.5.p4.b4.text: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good …

thessalonians1.5.p5.b4.text: for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

thessalonians1.5.p6.b2.text: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,

thessalonians1.5.p6.b3.text: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.

thessalonians1.5.p6.b4.text: Abstain from every form of evil.

thessalonians1.5.p7.b1.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, …

thessalonians1.5.p7.b2.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

thessalonians1.5.p7.b3.text: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.

thessalonians1.5.p7.b4.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
